name: Battlefield Obscuring
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level bloodlord 2, cleric/oracle 2, death mage 2, druid 2, magus 2, shaman 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, unchained summoner 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 minute

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Effect 100-ft.-radius cloud, 20 ft. high

This spell functions as obscuring mist except as noted above.
